description: AI video generation / text to video: a short clip from a text prompt with Google Veo, returned as a download link (video_url, valid 48 hours) with its MIME type, optionally with generated audio. Input: prompt; optional aspect_ratio (16:9 or 9:16), duration_seconds (4, 6 or 8), generate_audio, inline. $10.00 per call. Returns: prompt, aspect_ratio, duration_seconds, video_url (48 h), video_base64 when inline, mime_type, model.

inline.description: Also return the bytes as video_base64. Default false.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_video_generate
title: Generate a video
